exposure: Number of medications due within a 15-minute window
Concurrent vs. alternating administration of acetaminophen and ibuprofen or ketorolac
Timing of scheduled acetaminophen, ibuprofen, and ketorolac administration relative to scheduled time
outcome: Lateness of analgesic dose administration times
cohort: 3,163 women who underwent cesarean delivery at the University of Iowa between January 2021 and December 2023
finding: There was a wide range in lateness of analgesic administration (95% of doses administered between 108 minutes early and 181 minutes late), but there were minimal systematic differences in lateness based on factors such as concurrent vs. alternating administration of different analgesics, time of day, or weekday.
